title: Tension Headache
ayurvedicView: Tension headaches often stem from Vata imbalance. Relaxation, proper hydration, and stress management are key.
remedies: Apply diluted peppermint or lavender oil to temples
Drink ginger tea and stay well-hydrated
Gentle head and neck massage with warm sesame oil
Rest in a quiet, dimly lit room
Pudina (mint) tea and a few minutes away from screens

tm2Group.title: Head, brain, nerve and movement disorders (TM2)

seeDoctor: A sudden, severe headache, the worst you have had: seek care now
Headache with fever and a stiff neck, confusion, weakness, or trouble speaking or seeing: call 112
Headache after a head injury, or new headaches after age 50
